# `NeverMethodCalled`

`Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Exception\NeverMethodCalled`

**Class** — **Package:** [rasuvaeff/understudy](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy/blob/master/src/Exception/NeverMethodCalled.php#L14) — **Version:** v0.4.1

**Extends:** `RuntimeException`

**Implements:** `Throwable`, `Stringable`, [`Exception\UnderstudyError`](/api/classes/Exception/UnderstudyError)

A method declared `: never` was called without an expectation that throws.

Returning from it is impossible by language rule, so the dispatcher must
throw something — this says so explicitly instead of leaking a TypeError.
